name: Peugeot 208
sources: ADAC car catalogue, 208 1.2 PureTech 100 Allure EAT8 (12/19-08/20): length 4055, width 1745 (1960 with mirrors), height 1430, wheelbase 2540 mm; turning circle 10.4 m; 74 kW (100 PS), 205 Nm, front-wheel drive, 8-speed automatic; 0-100 km/h 10.8 s, top speed 188 km/h; kerb weight (EU) 1165 kg; it may tow 1200 kg with brakes or 580 kg without, 55 kg on the ball; 195/55 R16 tyres; rear parking aid standard. https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/peugeot/208/2generation/301239/
notes: Rear-axle frame: x forward from the rear axle, z to the right, metres. The black 208 parked beside bay 561 in your garage is one of these.
estimates: the turning circle is taken as kerb to kerb: ADAC gives only 'Wendekreis'
the track (1.50 m) and the overhangs (0.825 m front, 0.69 m rear): car databases, not Peugeot
the outline between the published length and width
the mirrors' size, place and height (only the width across them is published)

Drive mode: the weight split, the height of the centre of gravity, the drag area, the tyres' grip, the pull from rest and the slowing with no pedal; the share of the power the model gets is tuned so 0-100 km/h takes the published 10.8 s
